Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the opposite party no.

The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party No.2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.80566 of 2024(4) dt.05-05-2025 4.

5.
